name: SK Food Group Inc
old_description: Your Imagination, Our Acceleration: Lightning-Fast Custom Food Development & Assembly
about:
SK Food Group traces its roots to 1942 when it began as a mobile catering operation in Seattle, Washington. The company, now headquartered in Reno, Nevada, has grown through a series of ownership changes and name transitions—including Don Campbell's Quality Food Service in 1979 and Stover's Kitchen in 2004—before selling its catering division in 2006 to focus exclusively on food manufacturing.

Today the company operates nine state-of-the-art facilities across the United States and Canada, employing more than 2,000 associates. Its plants are custom-built for Ready-to-Eat production, featuring motorized conveyor systems, precision slicing lines for meat and cheese, and extensive cold-storage, dry-storage, and dock infrastructure. All locations are USDA or CFIA certified and carry SQF Version 9.1 certification; the Burnsville and Lakeville, Minnesota sites also hold USDA Organic and Gluten-Free certifications.

SK Food Group serves a broad spectrum of foodservice customers, from independent cafes to Fortune 500 brands, supplying handcrafted sandwiches, wraps, flatbreads, burgers, protein snacks, and charcuterie boards. The company also offers private-label development and assembly, working under strict confidentiality agreements to protect client recipes and packaging intellectual property.

The firm emphasizes a hands-on, confidential partnership model, positioning itself as a collaborator that moves from concept to production while maintaining rigorous food-safety standards. Its "Your Imagination, Our Acceleration" tagline reflects a focus on rapid custom development backed by high-capacity automation.
